predecessors.name: British Africa (remaining colonies)
predecessors.text: Southern Rhodesia: 'Rhodesia was the de facto successor to the self-governing colony of Southern Rhodesia'

successors.name: Zimbabwe Rhodesia
successors.text: the whole state under its new name: 'The country's name was changed to Zimbabwe Rhodesia'

ledger.x: 11 November 1965: Southern Rhodesia's government declares independence from the United Kingdom without British consent.
2 March 1970: Rhodesia declares itself a republic.
1 June 1979: Rhodesia becomes Zimbabwe Rhodesia under Bishop Muzorewa.

wars.name: Rhodesian Bush War
wars.outcome: Lancaster House Agreement: 'Military stalemate; ZANU/ZAPU political victory'; 'Rhodesia renamed; Zimbabwe gains internationally recognised independence'.

certainty.note: The frontier is the Southern Rhodesian colonial frontier, which no page opened records as changing between 1965 and 1979; the war's cross-border raids moved no line.
